rulings: CF-A-NAMED-SPECIALIZATION-IS-ITS-OWN-PRODUCT (#1715 class, 2026-09-07). Panini Haunted Hoops and NBA Hoops Premium Stock are DISTINCT PRODUCTS from Panini NBA Hoops -- each has its own checklist, its own parallels and its own market. `nba-hoops` carries the family word "Hoops", so every unanchored Hoops rule in the parser and the vocabulary swallowed both specializations. Ruled as normalizeSetKey fixed points in this PR (productSetKeys.ts, hobbyIqCardId.service.ts, parseTitleIdentity.service.ts) and mirrored into the SPECIALIZATION-STATED ladder (rematch-classify.cjs).

COUNT BY SOURCE, AND EVERY ROW IN THIS LIST IS CHECKLIST-BACKED. All 1,825 Haunted rows and all 14,970 Premium Stock rows carry source checklistinsider-2026-08-27 -- strict checklist rows, not sales-derived seeds. `nba-hoops` holds exactly five distinct (setName, source, year) shapes and these are two of them; the flagship keeps 26,250 rows of its own and is not touched by this list.

ONE CARD, ONE ROW, ONE POOL -- AND THE PARSER PICKED THE POOL BY PUNCTUATION. card_catalog already holds 2,100 rows at `panini-haunted-hoops` (setName "2024/25 Panini Haunted Hoops Basketball", hobbymonitor-2026-09-04) alongside these 1,825 at `nba-hoops`. Both populations are the SAME 300-card checklist: 1,200 identity keys (cardNumber|parallel|isAuto|printRun) appear in both and the playerName AGREES on all 1,200, with zero disagreements. They diverged only because normalizeSetKey answered three ways for one product name -- the slash-season form and the bare form fell to the flagship while the checklistinsider spelling reached the right key by a slugify accident.

NO DESTINATION IS OCCUPIED, MEASURED. The two catalog populations sit in different year segments (these 1,825 ids are :2024:, the 2,100 existing rows are :2025:), so all 1,825 reslug destinations are free -- 0 occupied, 0 different-player collisions. Nothing in this list asks the lane to route around an occupant; the lane would refuse if it did.

RESLUG, NEVER RETIRE. Every row here is a real card at a wrong address, so none is deleted and every sale that points at it is re-pointed by moveCatalogRow. Graded children ride with the move under the lane s own contract (#1920). No row in this list carries a `retire`.
